# NeoFoxi

> NeoFoxi is a software developer building fast, responsive websites, web and
> mobile apps, games, and custom Minecraft plugins, datapacks and mods.

NeoFoxi is an independent software developer focused on intuitive UI/UX on the
surface and robust architecture underneath. Work spans websites, cross-platform
apps, game projects, and Minecraft server tooling — software built to last.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://neofoxi.net): Portfolio and selected work (HardRevival, Atelier Dufour).
- [GitHub](https://neofoxi.net/github/): Redirect to github.com/NeoFoxi — source code and open projects.
- [Patreon](https://neofoxi.net/patreon/): Redirect to patreon.com/Technik_Wunder — membership and support.
- [YouTube](https://neofoxi.net/youtube/): Redirect to youtube.com/@NeoFoxi — videos and project demos.
- [Discord](https://neofoxi.net/discord/): Redirect to the NeoFoxi Discord profile.

## Selected work
- [HardRevival](https://hardrevival.net): Hardcore PvP Minecraft server, custom mod, and landing page with live leaderboards.
- [Atelier Dufour](https://atelierdufour.ch): Website for an art studio in Biel/Bienne, Switzerland.
